responsibility: Declares the full-HIR visitor responsible for enforcing Rust unsafe-context rules. The UnsafeChecker interface provides the crate entry point, helper routines for checking static accesses, function calls, and unsafe-relevant attributes, and the full traversal hook set used to walk HIR while maintaining a stacked unsafe context and consulting resolver/type-check/mapping state.
same_name_distinction: Defines the UnsafeChecker class interface and its full HIR visitor contract, listing the helper checks and visit hooks plus stored resolver/type-check/mapping state; the companion .cc file supplies the traversal logic and emitted diagnostics.
